Who we are

            
          

          

            

              
Alpacked is a DevOps company: consulting, dedicated engineers and fully managed infrastructure for teams of any size. Most of our work starts with legacy that needs modernising and ends with delivery that runs on autopilot.

              
We believe senior experience pays for itself — it shortens the path to results and to a return on your IT spend. That’s why our partners get to focus on their product while we look after everything underneath it.
